name: mzizi
description: Build with Mzizi: seven Mzizi agent skills (@nyuchi/mzizi-skills 0.20.0: mzizi-language, mzizi-roots, mzizi-design, mukoko-design, mzizi-backend, mzizi-architecture, discoverability), the /mzizi:component and /mzizi:scaffold commands, the fundi architecture agent, and the Mzizi MCP at mcp.mzizi.dev (free, no account; sign-in only for the Fundi tools). The 21-family palette, the shell first, Mzizi Roots components in Rust first, the Mzizi language, and the Ubuntu doctrine. Markdown and an MCP connection only: no scripts and no hooks. Owned and operated by Mzizi; live at mzizi.dev.

interface.longDescription: Build with Mzizi, the programming language and the components that support it. The plugin carries the seven public Mzizi agent skills (@nyuchi/mzizi-skills 0.20.0): mzizi-language, mzizi-roots, mzizi-design, mukoko-design, mzizi-backend, mzizi-architecture and discoverability, and connects the Mzizi MCP server at https://mcp.mzizi.dev/mcp, free with no account (sign-in only for the Fundi tools). It runs nothing on your machine.
